powershell: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path "results\jev-monitor" | Out-Null; $src="E:\0apps\jev-chat-windows\tools"; Copy-Item -Path "code\connect\wsl_probe.sh" -Destination "$src\wsl_probe.sh" -Force; $t=[IO.File]::ReadAllText("$src\wsl_probe.sh").Replace("`r",""); [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$src\wsl_probe.sh",$t); $r=(Get-Location).Path; $rw="/mnt/"+$r.Substring(0,1).ToLower()+(($r.Substring(2)) -replace "\\","/"); foreach($d in @("Ubuntu-26.04","Ubuntu-24.04")){ & wsl.exe -d $d -e bash "$src\wsl_probe.sh" "$rw/results/jev-monitor/wsl-$d.txt" 2>$null | Out-Null }; Get-ChildItem "results\jev-monitor\wsl-*.txt" | ForEach-Object { $_.Name+"="+$_.Length }
